title: kb-census skill's --resume argument is not mapped to census.py run --resume
goal: kb-census SKILL.md maps the skill's --resume argument to census.py run --resume, so a resumed census does not exit 2 on a log that already holds phase-2 outcomes

run:
import sys
t = open('.claude/skills/kb-census/SKILL.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
arg = [l for l in t[:t.index('## Phases 0 and 1')].splitlines() if '`--resume`' in l]
ok = [l for l in arg if 'census.py run' in l and '--resume' in l.split('census.py run', 1)[1]]
print(len(arg), 'lines define the skill argument --resume;', len(ok), 'map it to census.py run --resume')
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
